reasoning: Smart opposed open enrollment (school choice) in a March 2025 KSMU Informed Voter Coalition interview, citing resource and transportation constraints: SPS lacks enough bus drivers to transport students to other districts. Her opposition is practical rather than ideological, aligning with prioritizing public school funding while not endorsing universal school choice. The question asked about Missouri's open enrollment bills (public-to-public transfers), the closest analog to the school-vouchers topic.
quote_text: "I do not think that I would be a supporter of this. I think that it has a lot of issues that need to be thought through because, from what I understand, the home district would be responsible for transporting these kids to a different district, and we don't have enough bus drivers for the students that we have that want to ride the bus. So, I would not be in favor of this."
